claim: DeepSeek-Reasoner has best verbal-confidence reliability on code reasoning, up to 0.680 ECE, 0.636 Brier better than other models.
quoted_support: DeepSeek-Reasoner achieves the best performance across various tasks, outperforming other models by up to 0.680, 0.636, and 13.652 in terms of ECE, Brier Score, and Performance Score, respectively.
candidate_component_bearing: L1 (execution-based code-reasoning labels; no release-date control) and L2 partially (reasoning vs non-reasoning DeepSeek-V3/R1; verbal only, no probes). Core claim on code with execution labels: partial; code-reasoning tasks (I/O prediction), not code generation.

breadth.confidence_families: verbalized intrinsic confidence, reassess (self-doubt) confidence, reflective LLM confidence, Platt scaling (Sec. 3.2-3.3)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present (searched: base vs instruct pair)
breadth.reasoning_models: yes: DeepSeek-R1 vs V3 (Sec. 4.3); reasoning enabled via R1 model
breadth.elicitation_formats: answer plus confidence in one prompt; reassess re-prompt; separate reflective LLM (Sec. 3.3, Fig. 2)
breadth.benchmarks: REval (3,152; CCP, PSP, EPP, OP) and CRUXEval (800; I and O) (Table 1)
breadth.label_source: exact-match correctness of code-reasoning answers (Sec. 3.2); no code generation test execution
breadth.causal_intervention: no hidden-state intervention; prompt and Platt only
